description:
**Seeta University** is inviting applications for the position of **Lab Technician (Anatomy)** in a re-advertisement of positions for academic staff. This is a full-time role supporting the anatomy laboratory at the University's campus in **Mbalala, Mukono**.

## About the role

The Lab Technician (Anatomy) will support teaching and research in the anatomy laboratory, preparing specimens and practical materials for student sessions, maintaining laboratory equipment and records, and ensuring that the laboratory runs safely and efficiently. You will work closely with academic staff and students, and produce clear, accurate reports on laboratory activities.

## Qualifications

- Must hold a Bachelor of Biomedical Science with a minimum CGPA of 3.6
- Three (3) years of laboratory practice experience at a reputable university
- Must have good report-writing skills

## How to apply

All applications must be **sealed in an envelope** and submitted to the **Office of the Director of Human Resources** at Seeta University in **Mbalala, Mukono**.

All applications should be addressed to:

- The Director of Human Resources
- Seeta University
- P.O. Box 417, Mbalala, Mukono

For more information, visit **www.su.sc.ug**.

## Deadline

**4:00 PM, Tuesday 25th August 2026**.
